title: One product, by the id MongoDB made

requests.msg: GET /api/products/6ac931504a64885a883b6c1c must reply 200 with the Pen: the first if must be true only when the text cannot be an id (a ! in front of ObjectId.isValid), and the filter of findOne is { _id: new ObjectId(req.params.id) }
GET /api/products/6ac931504a64885a883b6c1b must reply 200 with the Notebook: the id must be the one in the address, req.params.id
an id that is well formed but belongs to no product must be answered 404 with { error: "No such product" }
GET /api/products/2 must be answered 400 with { error: "Not an id" }: 2 cannot be an id, so the test of the first if is !ObjectId.isValid(req.params.id)

source.msg: t2.js compares the _id with text: make the text of the address into an id with new ObjectId(req.params.id)
t2.js does not test the id yet: ObjectId.isValid(req.params.id) says whether the text can be an id
a database call is not waited for: write await in front of it, or the next line runs before the answer has come
